```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(pwr)
```

## Power analysis (multiple linear regression)
# reference: https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/pwr/pwr.pdf#page=12.08

```{r power, include=TRUE}
result_bsl <- pwr.f2.test(
  u = 7,           # 8 regions - 1
  f2 = 0.15,       # hypothetical medium effect (small = 0.02; large = 0.35)
  sig.level = 0.05,
  power = 0.80
)

# Residual degrees of freedom -> sample size
# v = N - k - 1 --> N = v + k + 1 (v = residual degrees of freedom; k = total number of predictor coefficients)
# region: 8
# age (continuous): 1
# own-region advantage (binary): 1
# intercept: 1
ceiling(result_bsl$v + 9 + 1)

result_isl <- pwr.f2.test(
  u = 3,           # 4 regions - 1
  f2 = 0.15,
  sig.level = 0.05,
  power = 0.80
)

ceiling(result_isl$v + 5 + 1)
```
